title: VIX-timed monthly NIFTY iron condor
hypothesis: A monthly NIFTY iron condor sold only when India VIX exceeds the 20-session realised volatility by a threshold earns a positive return on margin after charges, and more than the same condor sold every month.

mechanism.text: Index option buyers pay for crash insurance; the seller is paid for carrying the crash. A wide implied-over-realised spread should mean a richer premium.

evidence.source: Carr and Wu, Review of Financial Studies 22(3)
evidence.finding: Variance risk premia are large and negative for index options buyers.

evidence.source: NIFTY variance risk premium study, SDMIMD journal (informaticsjournals.com)
evidence.finding: Consistently positive, significant VRP; volatility-selling strategies tested.

evidence.source: Jain, Varma and Agarwalla, Journal of Futures Markets
evidence.finding: Indian single-stock IV far above realised.
Strangles and condors REJECT out of sample; one gap erased months of premium.

universe.name: nifty-monthly-options
universe.rule: The monthly expiry at least 21 calendar days away on the entry session; strikes that traded that day.

holding_period: 3 to 5 weeks, one position at a time

turnover.basis: charges and slippage about 8% of the credit a condor (see the brief); drag on capital depends on the credit, so 0 here and the per-trade cost is in the backtest

prior_trials.basis: The five options library specs' grids (12 + 4 + 9 + 12 + 9) on the same family of short premium.

holdout_rule.pass_if: Holdout return on margin above zero after charges over at least 20 condors, and above the untimed condor with the same strikes.

kill_criteria: Holdout return on margin at or below zero.
The timed condor no better than the untimed one in validation (the filter is noise).
Any single position losing more than 3 months of the average credit in validation.

prior.reason: The premium is real, but this repo's condors and strangles all failed and costs take about 8% of the credit.

feasibility.reason: The options engine exists; needs the VRP filter (#73) and legacy bhavcopies (#71).

contamination: The five options library specs (46 grid points, short premium on NIFTY and BANKNIFTY) ran on F&O bhavcopies from 2024-01-01 to 2026-10-30, so most of the holdout has been looked at for related rules. The VIX-minus-realised filter has not been run.
